data.name: William
data.gender_notes: William is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic wil, 'will, desire', + helm, 'helmet, protection'. Its root is Germanic wil + helm. A common Christian name across Europe. William is a Germanic name meaning “Resolute protector; will helmet”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: William expresses “Resolute protector; will helmet”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Germanic wil, 'will, desire', + helm, 'helmet, protection'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of William total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
